dct_description_sm:
This feature layer contains the Base Spatial Forest Inventory (BSFI) Photo Year dataset. This data can be used to identify the date of imagery acquisition. The years represented in this layer correspond with the date of that aerial imagery is collected and interpreted through the soft-copy interpretation processes.

Administered by the GIS and Mapping Division, this layer can be used in conjunction with the FFA - Land Cover - Newfoundland feature layer.
